This Open GIS Data Portal provides residents, visitors, business owners and investors a means to easily find, access and view information through the use of maps and mapping technology. Simply search for a specific dataset below or explore the data categories. To learn more about how to use the Open GIS Data Portal view this tutorial.


By downloading data from this site you are agreeing to the terms of the Open Data License.

https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.title: Planning Applications
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.description:
This dataset represents all active planning and development applications currently under review within the City of Barrie. It provides up-to-date spatial and attribute information on development proposals that are in progress through the municipal planning approvals process.
Included application types:

Site Plan Applications
Draft Plans of Subdivision
Zoning By-law Amendments (Re-zoning)
Official Plan Amendments

The layer is intended to support public transparency, internal workflows, and stakeholder awareness by illustrating where development activity is occurring across the city. Each record typically includes key details such as application type, status, location, file number, and associated planning information.

The City of Barrie is situated in the heart of Central Ontario, a premier waterfront community on Lake Simcoe, conveniently located an hour north of Toronto.  Visit barrie.ca for more information or contact Service Barrie at 705-726-4242 or ServiceBarrie@barrie.ca

The City of Barrie makes every effort to ensure that the information is accurate and up to date, but does not guarantee or warrant its quality, reliability, completeness, currency, or suitability for any particular purpose.
